item.title: How I Turned My Laptop Into a Dumb Terminal With a Tailscale Dev VM, T3 Code, and Claude Code
item.description: A persistent dev VM over Tailscale running T3 Code and Claude Code turns any laptop into a thin client, and why I'm stripping Windows down instead of upgrading.

item.title: Running Ollama in a Proxmox LXC with NVIDIA GPU Passthrough
item.description: Set up Ollama in a Proxmox LXC with NVIDIA GPU passthrough, Tailscale access and Open WebUI. Run local LLMs with GPU acceleration on your own hardware.

item.title: How to Migrate VMs Between Standalone Proxmox Nodes Without Clustering
item.description: A complete guide to migrating VMs between standalone Proxmox hosts without clustering, using vzdump streaming over SSH

item.title: Passing Through an NVMe Drive to an ESXi Virtual Machine
item.description: Pass through NVMe drives to ESXi virtual machines via RDM raw device mapping. Enable VM direct storage access to physical NVMe disks for specialised workloads.

item.title: Running Uptime Kuma With Docker Compose
item.description: Deploy Uptime Kuma website and API monitoring with Docker Compose. Self-hosted uptime tracker and status page for infrastructure monitoring in a home lab.

item.title: Unraid USB Controller Passthrough - VM hot swap USB
item.description: Pass a USB controller through to an UNRAID VM for hot-swappable USB devices, using an Inateck PCIe card and libvirt device configuration.

item.title: Collect bitcoin price data with python and Coinbase
item.description: Collect live Bitcoin prices from the Coinbase API with Python 3, store the readings in InfluxDB and chart the trend in Grafana.

item.title: How to pass through a drive to a UNRAID VM
item.description: Pass a physical drive straight to an UNRAID VM for raw storage access and keep an existing Windows install by attaching its SSD to a KVM VM.

item.title: Copy Paste in vSphere before installing VMware tools
item.description: Send text into a vSphere VM before VMware Tools is installed using AutoIT keystrokes, getting round the clipboard limit during fresh OS installs.

item.title: Backup Nextcloud with RCLONE
item.description: Back up a self-hosted Nextcloud instance to UNRAID NAS using Rclone WebDAV integration. Automated encrypted cloud-to-local sync with selective folder targeting.

item.title: Convert an ESXi VM to UNRAID KVM with qume-img convert
item.description: Convert an ESXi VMDK virtual machine to UNRAID KVM with qemu-img convert, keeping the Windows drivers and boot configuration intact.

item.title: How to make a VirtualBox VM the same resolution as host
item.description: Match a VirtualBox VM's resolution to the host display with the VBoxSVGA controller, fullscreen scaling and dynamic resolution adjustment.

item.title: Clipboard and Shared Folders on Kali Linux with VirtualBox
item.description: Enable clipboard sync and shared folders for Kali Linux in VirtualBox by installing virtualbox-guest-x11.
